_note: AI-drafted tool schemas for the Kitna benchmark. Synthetic services; no real API. x-kitna-kind tells the grader how to normalise an argument; x-graded=false marks free text that is not scored.

send_money.description: Send money from the user's bank account to a saved payee.

amount_inr: Amount in Indian rupees, as a plain number (250000, not '2.5 lakh').
schedule_date: Date to send on, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to send now.

amount_inr: Amount in Indian rupees, as a plain number.
due_date: Date to pay on, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to pay now.

check_balance.description: Show the balance of one of the user's accounts.

travel_class: Class: SL sleeper, 3A, 2A, 1A, CC chair car.

pickup_time: Pickup date and time in IST, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (24-hour).

max_price_inr: Highest fare in rupees, as a plain number.

title: string
string
What to remind the user about.

create_event.description: Add an event to the user's calendar.

title: string
string
Event title.
duration: Length as an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT1H30M.

set_alarm.description: Set an alarm for the next occurrence of a clock time.

place_order.description: Order a product from the shopping app.

max_price_inr: Highest price per unit in rupees, as a plain number.

set_price_alert.description: Notify the user when a product reaches a price.

target_price_inr: Target price in rupees, as a plain number.

order_id: Order ID, e.g. OD-12345, if the problem is about an order.
amount_inr: Amount in dispute in rupees, as a plain number.
incident_date: Date the problem happened or is expected, YYYY-MM-DD.

request_callback.description: Ask a support agent to phone the user.

callback_time: When to call, in IST, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (24-hour).

check_refund_status.description: Show the status of a refund.
